S4 Methods for SurveyMixr Objects

Source: R/methods.R
surveymixr-methods.Rd

Standard methods for objects returned by surveymixr functions.

Creates bar plots of class-specific means for distal variables.

Usage

# S4 method for class 'SurveyMixr'
show(object)

# S4 method for class 'SurveyMixr'
print(x, ...)

# S4 method for class 'SurveyMixr'
summary(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'SurveyMixr'
coef(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'SurveyMixr'
vcov(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'SurveyMixr'
fitted(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'SurveyMixr'
residuals(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'SurveyMixr'
logLik(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'SurveyMixr'
AIC(object, ..., k = 2)

# S4 method for class 'SurveyMixr'
BIC(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'SurveyMixrSelect'
show(object)

# S4 method for class 'SurveyMixrSelect'
print(x, ...)

# S4 method for class 'SurveyMixrSelect'
summary(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'R3StepResults'
show(object)

# S4 method for class 'R3StepResults'
print(x, ...)

# S4 method for class 'R3StepResults'
summary(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'R3StepResults'
plot(x, y, type = "means", ...)

# S4 method for class 'ConvergenceDiagnostics'
show(object)

# S4 method for class 'ConvergenceDiagnostics'
print(x, ...)

# S4 method for class 'SurveyMixr'
plot(x, y, type = "trajectories", ...)

Arguments

object

A SurveyMixr object

x

An object of class R3StepResults

...

Additional arguments passed to plotting functions

k

Integer specifying class number (for class-specific methods)

y

Not used (required for S4 plot signature)

type

Character string: "trajectories" (default), "entropy", "convergence", or "class_sizes"

Value

The show, print, and plot methods are called for their side effects (displaying or plotting results) and return the object invisibly. The summary method returns an enhanced summary of the model invisibly. Other methods return specific values:

show()

No return value, called for side effects (displays object summary)

print()

No return value, called for side effects (prints object summary)

summary()

No return value, called for side effects (prints detailed summary)

coef()

Named vector of all model parameters (class proportions and growth parameters)

vcov()

Variance-covariance matrix of parameter estimates

fitted()

Matrix of fitted trajectories (rows = individuals, columns = time points)

residuals()

Matrix of residuals (observed - fitted values)

logLik()

Log-likelihood value with attributes for degrees of freedom and sample size

AIC()

Akaike Information Criterion value

BIC()

Bayesian Information Criterion value

plot()

No return value, called for side effects (generates plots)
